name: webni-custom-version-1
description: Webni Custom Version 1 Theme — WordPress + WooCommerce theme for BP|DL Parfum

scripts.import: wp-env run cli wp theme activate webni-custom-version-1 && wp-env run cli wp eval 'print_r( webni_import_demo_products() );'
scripts.pot: wp-env run cli wp i18n make-pot /var/www/html/wp-content/themes/webni-custom-version-1 /var/www/html/wp-content/themes/webni-custom-version-1/languages/webni-custom-version-1.pot --domain=webni-custom-version-1 --exclude=assets/fonts,assets/images
